CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFASSOCIATE

When custom tags work as a family (a menu and its items, an order and its lines), the inner tags use CFASSOCIATE to file their Attributes with the outer "base" tag. The base tag finds them, one structure per child tag, in an array when it runs in end mode.

Category

Extensibility

Syntax

<CFASSOCIATE BASETAG="CF_TAGNAME"
    DATACOLLECTION="collection_name">

Attributes

BASETAG
Required. Name of the ancestor tag to associate with, written as it was called: "CF_SN_CART" for a tag called as <CF_SN_CART>, "CFMODULE" for one called through CFMODULE.
DATACOLLECTION
Optional, default "AssocAttribs". Name of the array in the base tag's ThisTag scope that receives the attributes.

Usage

CFASSOCIATE belongs in the child tag's template, not in the calling page. If the named base tag is not among the ancestors, an error is raised. The base tag reads the array (ThisTag.AssocAttribs by default) in end mode, after all the children have run; it usually also clears ThisTag.GeneratedContent so that the children's whitespace does not show.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<!--- sn_cart.cfm is the base tag, sn_cartitem.cfm the child; both live in this directory --->
<CF_SN_CART CUSTOMER="Ada Lovelace">
  <CF_SN_CARTITEM ITEM="56K modem" QTY="1" PRICE="129.95">
  <CF_SN_CARTITEM ITEM="Zip disks (10 pack)" QTY="2" PRICE="89.50">
  <CF_SN_CARTITEM ITEM="Y2K compliance sticker" QTY="5" PRICE="0.99">
</CF_SN_CART>
